Name: Sprint - A faster and stamina draining run
Author: Yoshify
Description:
Sprint is a faster version of run that will drain your stamina over time. It's fully configurable, included in the config are the following values:

[b]SprintKey=X [/b]- X by default, but you can change it to whatever! Included in the config file will be a list of accepted Keys.
[b]SprintToggle=false [/b]- false (off) by default, enabling this (true) will have make the sprint toggleable.
[b]SpeedModifier=1 [/b]- The amount to be added onto the base speed.
[b]StaminaDrainAmount=1 [/b]- The amount of stamina drained.
[b]StaminaDrainRateInSeconds=5 [/b]- The rate of which the stamina is drained, in seconds.

Please note that this requires the latest [url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url] to use. Simply drag and drop the contents of the downloaded zip into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley directory.

Please report any bugs to me, and as always, enjoy! [img]http://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img]
